102: An unprecedented series of violent tornadoes is sweeping across Oklahoma. All The Uproarious Fun Of the Smash Broadway Play!

For everyone who loved "Emma" and "Sense & Sensibility" comes the comedy Jane Austen loved best.

7526: An introspective dentist's suspicions about his wife's infidelity stresses his mental well being and family life to the breaking point.

RECKLESS with WOMEN...He pursued them ..."petted" them...promised them nothing and got away with everything!

The fall of an empire will be the rise of another.

Her passion was cooking, her obsession was deadly

You've never seen a honeymoon like this

In the land of the blind the one eyed girl is Queen

Feared by the British... forgotten by his countrymen.

HE'S TERRIFIC! Your Favorite Crime Crusader!

Courage...Treachery...and Love --- AND THE GREAT EVERGLADES INDIAN WARS!
